description: Provides a set of WireframeComponentSchema entries to the WireframeSchemaRegistry. Implement this interface to supply component schemas from any source (database, configuration, external API) and register it via services.AddWireframeSchemaSource<T>(). The built-in implementation is BuiltInComponentSchemas with Priority=0.

members.name: SourceId
members.description: Unique identifier for this source, used in logging and diagnostics.

members.name: Priority
members.description: Higher priority wins when two sources register the same component type. Built-in source uses 0; set higher (e.g. 10) to override built-in schemas.

members.name: GetSchemas()
members.description: Returns all component schemas supplied by this source.

usage:
services.AddWireframeSchemas(); // registers BuiltInComponentSchemas
services.AddWireframeSchemaSource<MyDbSchemaSource>(); // add custom source
